thread:
sre-bot: Incident started: Dedicated fleet experienced sustained heap-growth after a recent heap-trimming change. We're seeing 503s on a subset of high-throughput dedicated nodes in us-east-2.

morgan: Confirming, approx 09:07 UTC we started seeing increased OOM kills and connection resets. Impacting 3 dedicated clusters and a handful of customers. No hosted API customers affected.

devon: Repro steps: heap-trim config flagged aggressive compaction at 60s which interacts poorly with our jitted allocator under high-concurrency. Putting rollback now.

morgan: Rolling back heap-trim change to previous stable config on affected hosts. Command: `kubectl apply -f /configs/heap-trim/stable.yaml --namespace=dedicated` — running.

sre-bot: Rollback in progress (jobs queued). ETA ~6m for rolling restarts across the three clusters.

priya: Notifying affected accounts via CS with mitigation note. Draft posted to #customer-success for review: https://redwood.internal/drafts/heap-trim-notice

sam: Can we add a temporary autoscale-up to soak traffic while rolling? `autoscaler set --scale 20 --pool dedicated-us-east-2`

devon: Yes doing that now, +20% capacity. Will watch heap and connection errors.

morgan: Early metrics look good, errors dropping from 40% -> 6% in the last 3m.

katie: Preparing public status update. Proposed message: "We experienced degraded service for some Dedicated customers in us-east-2 between 09:07–09:25 UTC due to a runtime memory regression; rollback completed and normal service restored. Full postmortem to follow." :thumbsup:

lee: CS will send targeted emails once we get confirmation of full recovery.

sre-bot: Incident resolved — rollback completed and autoscale scaled back. Final impact window: 09:07–09:25 UTC. Postmortem assigned: /incident/2345678901/postmortem

morgan: Follow-ups: (1) revert aggressive trimming from main branch, (2) add canary config change to runtime deploy checklist, (3) create alert for rapid heap-growth spike detection.

priya: Added to roadmap and will coordinate with devon for a safer compaction rollout.

sam: Thanks all, great triage. Closing the thread after AFK sweep. :white_check_mark:

katie: Public status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2345678901 — will post update 30m.

sre-bot: Logs and timing exported to incident runbook: https://redwood.internal/incident/2345678901/logs
